title: 2. IAAA + Non-Repudiation
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L06: Security Principles & Mindset: 2. IAAA + Non-Repudiation .

items: Authentication — proof of identity (something you know/have/are)
Accountability / Auditing — recording actions for traceability

blocks.text: IAAA is the access-control loop every system implements, from a Linux login to AWS IAM. Most breaches are failures in one of these four steps.

items: Something you have — smartcard, hardware token, phone
Something you are — biometric (fingerprint, iris, face)
MFA requires factors from different categories — two passwords ≠ MFA
A party cannot deny performing an action
Achieved via digital signatures + audit trails
Combines authentication + integrity → required for legal / commerce
Symmetric crypto alone cannot provide non-repudiation (shared key)
